releaseNotes.zh-CN: 更新截图钉前端：重新布局截图卡片与操作区，优化工具箱主题适配，加入轻动画、加载占位、复制完成反馈和截图比例标识。清空操作需在三秒内再次点击确认；框选后钉到桌面、双击打开贴图及现有贴图操作保留。安装包改由 modules 分支直接提供，无需模块 Release。
releaseNotes.en-US: Refresh the Screen Pin board layout and host-themed styling with subtle motion, loading placeholders, copy feedback and aspect-ratio labels. Clearing all pins requires a second click within three seconds. Preserve capture-to-pin, double-click floating windows and existing pin controls. Serve the package directly from the modules branch without a module Release.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 已发布的 Rust/Tauri 独立模块版本。本地后续改动尚未发布。
releaseNotes.en-US: Published Rust/Tauri module generation. Subsequent local changes are not published yet.
